Since I can't create a GitLab account due to disabled registration, the documented installation path is blocked by a credential issue—this points to either a missing external resource or incomplete documentation. The documentation does mention a development mode for running from source, but that's not part of the official installation guide.

I'm considering whether I could attempt a source-based install as an alternative approach, though I'm weighing whether that's a legitimate documented method or if it falls outside the scope of what the installation guide actually covers.

The development docs show a local run procedure with Python 3.12, Node 22+, uv sync, and npm ci, but this requires downloading large models that are gated behind HF tokens—pyannote models need form-based approval, and faster-whisper-large-v3 is around 3GB. I can't create a HF account without email access, and even if I could, gated access typically requires manual form approval that may involve review. I should check whether the faster-whisper model is actually gated on Hugging Face to understand the full scope of what's blocked.

The core issue is that without a valid HF token, I can't download the gated models needed for the ASR service to function properly, which means I can't verify the transcription pipeline end-to-end. The docker-compose setup is the recommended path, but it requires credentials for a private registry that are inaccessible from this environment. I should continue monitoring the pull to see what happens, while checking whether faster-whisper-large-v3 requires authentication and what Hugging Face's public API shows for gated access.

action.command: for m in "Systran/faster-whisper-large-v3" "pyannote/speaker-diarization-3.1" "pyannote/segmentation-3.0" "pyannote/wespeaker-voxceleb-resnet34-LM" "speechbrain/lang-id-voxlingua107-ecapa"; do enc=$(python3 -c "import urllib.parse,sys;print(urllib.parse.quote(sys.argv[1],safe=''))" "$m" 2>/dev/null || echo "$m"); code=$(timeout 30 curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "https://huggingface.co/api/models/$enc"); gated=$(timeout 30 curl -sS "https://huggingface.co/api/models/$enc" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '"gated":[a-z]+' | head -1); echo "$m -> HTTP $code $gated"; done
